Installing dependencies from lock file (including require-dev)
Verifying lock file contents can be installed on current platform.
Your lock file does not contain a compatible set of packages. Please run composer update.

  Problem 1
    - a/lib is locked to version 1.0.0 and an update of this package was not requested.
    - a/lib 1.0.0 requires c/d ^1.0 -> could not be found in any version, there may be a typo in the package name.
  Problem 2
    - a/lib is locked to version 1.1.0 and an update of this package was not requested.
    - a/lib 1.0.0 requires c/d ^1.0 -> could not be found in any version, there may be a typo in the package name.
    - a/lib 1.1.0 is an alias of a/lib 1.0.0 and thus requires it to be installed too.

Potential causes:
 - A typo in the package name
 - The package is not available in a stable-enough version according to your minimum-stability setting
   see <https://getcomposer.org/doc/04-schema.md#minimum-stability-root-only> for more details.
 - It's a private package and you forgot to add a custom repository to find it

Read <https://getcomposer.org/doc/articles/troubleshooting.md> for further common problems.
